purpose: Read-only map from a migrating preparer's familiar commands to the native NXT Tax destination that actually exists today.
limitations: This is a command and capability inventory, not a menu tree, a calculation claim or a filing claim. Source labels were recovered from installed resources, published pages and one read-only signed-in T2 workspace. No source calculation was executed, nothing was saved or filed, and no client value is retained. A native destination is a narrower NXT workflow and is not proof of source equivalence.

sources.label: DT Max
sources.role: T1 / T2 / T3 / T5013 preparation, review and EFILE
sources.observation_note: Compiled UTF-16 command labels in the installed English interface library. Commands, dialogs and accelerators were not executed.

evidence.installed_version_source: Windows uninstall registry, DT Max - System 29.30.0000

entries.label: Client list
entries.native_scope: The NXT Tax worklist is a searchable return list that filters by program, year, status and jurisdiction, and sorts by name, tax year, last updated or status. It is a return worklist, not a DT Max client database. F10 opens it from anywhere in the tax app.
entries.next_step: Map source client identity to the imported roster before treating a worklist row as a client.

entries.label: Client verification
entries.native_scope: Roster status and source-review cards show verified and pending contexts; there is no DT Max client-verification dialog.
entries.next_step: Define which source verification states must be reproduced before migration acceptance.

entries.label: Client renumbering
entries.native_scope: NXT Tax has no client renumbering operation. Imported source client numbers are retained verbatim as provenance.
entries.next_step: Add a client-number remap that preserves the imported source number as provenance.
entries.scope_reason: Client renumbering rewrites a local client database. NXT keeps imported source numbers as provenance and does not rewrite identity.

entries.label: Client restore
entries.native_scope: No per-client restore. Rollback is the whole-store backup and recovery path, which is a different scope.
entries.next_step: Add a per-client export/restore package over the store namespace.
entries.scope_reason: Per-client restore needs a client-level backup format DT Max owns. NXT recovery is whole-store.

entries.label: Client accessed / allowed / denied
entries.native_scope: The audit view records native tax events for this workspace. It does not reproduce DT Max per-client access decisions.
entries.next_step: Verified individual identity is a prerequisite for meaningful access records.

entries.label: Return verified
entries.native_scope: Native return statuses are draft, calculated, in review, approved, filed (recorded) and archived. There is no separate verified flag.
entries.next_step: Confirm how a source 'verified' return maps to a native review or approval status.

entries.label: Return archived
entries.native_scope: Archiving a native return keeps it readable and out of active work.
entries.next_step: None for the status itself; archive retention policy is a separate decision.

entries.label: Review required
entries.native_scope: Native returns carry an explicit in-review status and stale-review invalidation when inputs change.
entries.next_step: Confirm the source conditions that raised 'review required' so the native equivalent is not narrower.

entries.label: Keyword input
entries.native_scope: NXT Tax entry is a typed keyword workpaper with declared fields per program and year. Fields are original NXT schemas, not the DT Max dictionary. Alt+F7 focuses the keyword search inside an open return.
entries.next_step: Complete keyword-group and dependency coverage before claiming data-entry equivalence.

entries.label: Print keywords
entries.native_scope: Native reports export workpapers from saved calculations only.
entries.next_step: Decide whether a keyword printout is a required migration artifact.

entries.label: Installed keyword dictionary labels
entries.native_scope: NXT Tax retains label lookup from the installed dictionary for 19 exact years and 47,692 names. Labels only: no option meanings, dependencies or tax-line mapping.
entries.next_step: Recover enum option meanings and occurrence structure from the installed carriers before widening entry coverage.

entries.label: EFILE transmission
entries.native_scope: Electronic filing is disabled in NXT Tax. No transmission path is implemented or certified.
entries.next_step: Requires independent CRA EFILE registration, software certification and acceptance testing. External gate.
entries.scope_reason: EFILE transmission requires CRA EFILE registration, software certification and acceptance testing. It is disabled by design until those exist.

entries.label: EFILE reports
entries.native_scope: No EFILE reporting exists because no transmission exists.
entries.next_step: Store and render transmission-result reports; producing real results still requires the CRA filing gate.
entries.scope_reason: EFILE reports are produced from transmission results. Without a certified transmission path there is nothing to report.

entries.label: EFILE errors
entries.native_scope: Native calculation diagnostics are not transmission diagnostics.
entries.next_step: Model authority rejection codes behind the filing gate; no transmission today.
entries.scope_reason: EFILE error handling interprets authority rejections. It is part of the disabled filing gate.

entries.label: EFILE logs
entries.native_scope: No transmission log exists.
entries.next_step: Record transmission attempts locally once a certified path exists.
entries.scope_reason: EFILE logs record transmission attempts. There are no attempts to log while filing is disabled.

entries.label: EFILE defaults
entries.native_scope: No filer credentials or transmitter configuration is stored.
entries.next_step: Blocked behind the filing gate; also a secret-custody decision.
entries.scope_reason: EFILE defaults carry filer credentials and authority settings. They are part of the disabled filing gate.

entries.label: EFILE queue (individual / numeric)
entries.native_scope: Batch workpapers group native returns for internal preparation and output. This is not a transmission queue.
entries.next_step: Keep the two concepts distinct in operator guidance.

entries.label: EFILE accepted / rejected / acknowledged
entries.native_scope: Transmission outcome statuses do not exist. A native 'filed' status is a human record, not an authority acknowledgement.
entries.next_step: Do not model authority statuses until a real transmission path exists.
entries.scope_reason: Accepted/rejected/acknowledged statuses come from the authority. They cannot be modelled without a real transmission path.

entries.label: EFILE - Quebec
entries.native_scope: Quebec TP-1 is scoped only. No Quebec transmission or calculation path exists.
entries.next_step: Quebec authority requirements are a separate unresolved specification.
entries.scope_reason: Quebec authority requirements are a separate unresolved specification.

entries.label: Print the current page
entries.native_scope: Native printable HTML workpapers, with browser printing.
entries.next_step: Confirm which printed artifacts the firm must retain per return.

entries.label: Print selected pages
entries.source_label: Print selected pages to the printer
entries.native_scope: Native reports are generated per saved calculation revision, not as an arbitrary page selection.
entries.next_step: Decide whether page-range selection is required for acceptance.

entries.label: Print blank forms
entries.native_scope: NXT ships no official forms and produces no certified form output.
entries.next_step: Acquire published form specifications independently before rendering official forms.
entries.scope_reason: Printing official blank forms requires published form specifications and a print pipeline; both are external.

entries.label: Print client list
entries.native_scope: The tax worklist exports exactly the filtered, sorted rows as CSV: name, client reference, program, tax year, jurisdiction, status, calculation state and last update. There is no printer layout and no label sheet.
entries.next_step: Add a print stylesheet for the worklist only if the firm needs paper.

entries.label: Print client labels
entries.native_scope: No label layout or label printer integration.
entries.next_step: Add a client-label print sheet (Avery-compatible PDF) from client records.
entries.scope_reason: Client label printing needs label stock and a desktop print path.

entries.label: Print queue (by name / individual / numeric)
entries.native_scope: Batch workpapers order native returns for preparation; they do not queue printer output.
entries.next_step: Clarify whether an actual print queue is required or batch output is sufficient.

entries.label: Print to DT FileCabinet
entries.native_scope: No NXT document cabinet export. Engagement opaque-file versions are a different module and scope.
entries.next_step: Add a Document Manager export bundle that can be filed into an external cabinet.
entries.scope_reason: DT FileCabinet integration is vendor document management; NXT has no FileCabinet connection.

entries.label: CT23 D-File packing slip
entries.native_scope: Not implemented.
entries.next_step: Add a CT23 D-File packing-slip export once the firm confirms the format.
entries.scope_reason: CT23 D-File packing slips are an Ontario/Quebec interface format from the vendor; not modelled.

entries.label: User defaults
entries.native_scope: NXT Tax declares its scope and limits per program and year instead of a user-defaults dialog.
entries.next_step: None unless per-preparer defaults become an acceptance requirement.

entries.label: Forms manager
entries.native_scope: No form manager; no vendor form assets are used.
entries.next_step: Add a form-catalogue view over published CRA forms with version pinning.
entries.scope_reason: The forms manager selects installed form files. NXT has no installed form library.

entries.label: Printing options
entries.native_scope: Report output options are limited to native report design and browser print.
entries.next_step: Widen only against a stated printing requirement.

entries.label: Billing setup
entries.native_scope: Tax billing is not implemented in NXT Tax.
entries.next_step: Move time/WIP billing into Firm Operations with rate tables and invoice generation.
entries.scope_reason: Billing setup configures DT Max's own time/billing add-on, which NXT does not ship.

entries.label: Text macros setup
entries.native_scope: Reusable text snippets are managed from the return editor and inserted into review notes; they are workspace text, not filing content.
entries.next_step: Return editor -> Text snippets (Insert / Manage).
entries.scope_reason: Text macros are desktop template expansion. NXT has no macro library.

entries.label: User interface options
entries.native_scope: NXT has no user-interface options dialog; it uses a single responsive theme with light and dark appearance.
entries.next_step: Add workspace layout preferences per operator.
entries.scope_reason: UI options configure the desktop application's own layout, which has no NXT equivalent by design.

entries.label: Audit trail setup
entries.native_scope: Native audit events are recorded; the trail is not user-configurable.
entries.next_step: Confirm retention and review requirements.

entries.label: Database maintenance
entries.native_scope: No client-facing database rebuild. Recovery is a provider-level backup and restore procedure.
entries.next_step: Add an operator maintenance job with a dry-run verification report.
entries.scope_reason: Database maintenance compacts a local desktop database. NXT keeps state in a hosted store with its own operations.

entries.label: Database in use
entries.native_scope: No file-lock model; NXT is a hosted multi-request service.
entries.next_step: Add per-return editing locks with an explicit takeover flow.
entries.scope_reason: This is a desktop single-user lock notice. NXT has no local database file to lock.

entries.label: Help and knowledge base
entries.source_label: Help and knowledge base files not found.
entries.native_scope: NXT documents declared scope and limits in-module; it does not ship a vendor knowledge base.
entries.next_step: Preparer help content is an open authoring task.

sources.label: WebTax4B
sources.role: Online T2 / AT1 / CO-17 corporate return preparation and filing
sources.observation_summary: Observed in published assets, shipped client code and a signed-in workspace

Only navigator topics, field labels and control names were retained; no corporation name, business number, address, amount or other client value is recorded here, and nothing was saved, calculated or filed.

Uncredentialled stylesheet linked from the T2 sign-in page.

entries.label: Corporation Internet Filing
entries.native_scope: NXT Tax does not transmit. Filing is disabled and no certification is claimed.
entries.next_step: Requires independent CRA certification and authority acceptance tests. External gate.
entries.scope_reason: Corporation Internet Filing requires independent CRA certification and authority acceptance tests.

entries.label: T2 barcode filing
entries.native_scope: No official T2 form rendering or barcode generation.
entries.next_step: Acquire published form and barcode specifications independently.
entries.scope_reason: T2 barcode filing requires published form and barcode specifications.

entries.label: T2 paper return in PDF
entries.source_label: T2 paper return in pdf format
entries.native_scope: Native printable HTML workpapers are internal documents, explicitly not an official T2 return.
entries.next_step: Keep the distinction visible in every printed artifact.

entries.label: Pre-validate T2 filing
entries.native_scope: No authority pre-validation. Native calculation diagnostics are local only.
entries.next_step: Blocked behind the filing gate.
entries.scope_reason: Pre-validation is an authority service; native diagnostics are local only.

entries.label: Submit attached documents online
entries.native_scope: No authority attachment channel.
entries.next_step: Blocked behind the filing gate.
entries.scope_reason: Submitting attachments online requires a certified authority channel.

entries.label: E-File T1135 (foreign property)
entries.native_scope: T1135 is not modelled.
entries.next_step: Add a T1135 data-collection worksheet; filing stays behind the CRA gate.
entries.scope_reason: T1135 is a CRA filing. Without an authority channel NXT would only collect the numbers; filing stays blocked.

entries.label: Auto-fill return (AFR)
entries.native_scope: NXT has native AFR slip and tag import for supported slips, with source preservation. It is not a T2 return auto-fill and it does not contact CRA.
entries.next_step: State the exact AFR shapes that are imported and tested; keep unsupported ones blocked.

entries.label: Request Web Access Code (WAC)
entries.native_scope: No CRA credential broker.
entries.next_step: Out of scope without a certified service.
entries.scope_reason: A Web Access Code is issued by CRA. NXT does not broker authority credentials.

entries.label: View NOA
entries.source_label: Auto-fill data from CRA, view NOA
entries.native_scope: No notice-of-assessment intake. Prior-year figures come only from preserved source facts.
entries.next_step: Add a notice-of-assessment document lane stored against a client year.
entries.scope_reason: A notice of assessment is a CRA document. NXT does not call CRA or receive notices.

entries.label: AT1-NETFILE / AT1-RSI (Alberta)
entries.native_scope: NXT computes bounded Alberta T2 arithmetic but does not produce or file an AT1.
entries.next_step: Independent Alberta form and transmission specifications are required.

entries.label: CO-17 online / paper (Quebec)
entries.source_label: CO-17 online filing via NETFILE Québec or clicSEQUR
entries.native_scope: No CO-17 calculation, form or filing.
entries.next_step: Quebec authority requirements remain a separate unresolved specification.

entries.label: CT23 (Ontario, to tax year 2009)
entries.source_label: CT23 certified by Ontario Ministry of Finance to tax year 2009
entries.native_scope: Not modelled; historical Ontario corporate returns are out of scope.
entries.next_step: Add historical CT23 data entry for pre-2010 years if a client needs it.
entries.scope_reason: CT23 is a historical Ontario corporate return (to 2009). Not modelled and not required for current clients.

entries.label: Upload financial statements from accounting software
entries.source_label: Upload financial statements from accounting software
entries.native_scope: Native import is a bounded, previewed import that creates a new draft; it does not silently absorb an accounting export.
entries.next_step: Verify the exact statement shapes accepted against real exports.

entries.label: Import data from other T2 software
entries.source_label: Import data from other T2 software
entries.native_scope: Native JSON package import is previewed before a draft is created. Vendor T2 formats are not supported.
entries.next_step: Declare unsupported vendor formats explicitly in the import screen.

entries.label: Auto carry-forward across years
entries.source_label: Tax data will be auto-carry forward into subsequent tax years
entries.native_scope: Native rollforward copies an exact prior source snapshot into a new draft; it is not an automatic year-over-year carry-forward of every field.
entries.next_step: Specify which lines must roll forward automatically before claiming this capability.

entries.label: Import data from CSV
entries.native_scope: NXT import is previewed and creates a new draft. It never replaces existing data, and the source dialog's overwrite-all warning has no native equivalent.
entries.next_step: Confirm which CSV shapes the firm actually imports before widening native intake.

entries.label: Capital cost allowance worksheet
entries.native_scope: Native T2 Schedule 8 computes CCA classes and the modelled allowances. There is no per-asset CCA popup keyed by class and taxpayer.
entries.next_step: Decide whether per-asset CCA detail is a migration requirement or the schedule total is sufficient.

entries.label: Home office expense
entries.native_scope: No home-office worksheet is modelled.
entries.next_step: Add a business-use-of-home worksheet for T2 with per-year rules.
entries.scope_reason: Home-office expense needs business-use-of-home rules per tax year. The native T2 scope declares ordinary active-business income only.

entries.label: Motor vehicle expense
entries.native_scope: Motor vehicle capital limits are modelled in Schedule 8; there is no vehicle expense worksheet.
entries.next_step: Add a motor-vehicle operating-expense worksheet distinct from CCA caps.
entries.scope_reason: A vehicle expense worksheet is separate from the CCA vehicle caps that Schedule 8 already models. Not in the declared scope.

entries.label: Other expenses
entries.native_scope: No other-expense worksheet.
entries.next_step: Add an other-expense worksheet with a declared line scope.
entries.scope_reason: Other-expense worksheets are not modelled; the native T2 scope declares a bounded expense set.

entries.label: Context help by field node
entries.native_scope: NXT documents declared scope per program and year. It has no per-field help system, and its source page links out to CRA publications rather than shipping annotations.
entries.next_step: Per-field guidance is an authoring task; it is not required for calculation parity.

entries.label: Top-level topic tabs (house buttons)
entries.native_scope: NXT Tax uses its own rail and in-return keyword navigation. The source's house-tab model is a styling and layout pattern, not a tax capability.
entries.next_step: None for parity; the native navigation is deliberate.

entries.label: Session log out
entries.native_scope: NXT uses its own workspace sign-in and session model; there is no per-source session to end.
entries.next_step: None. This entry exists so operators know the source session and the NXT session are separate.

entries.label: Identification
entries.native_scope: In-workpaper: a T2 workpaper carries corporate identification fields. There is no standalone identification tab.
entries.next_step: Confirm the identification fields the firm must retain verbatim from source returns.

entries.label: Corporate Info
entries.native_scope: In-workpaper: corporation name, business number and fiscal period are typed on the T2 corporate profile.
entries.next_step: Map source identity fields to the native profile before comparing figures.

entries.label: Tax information
entries.native_scope: NXT Tax declares its bounded 2025 Alberta scope instead of offering a tax-information tab.
entries.next_step: Widen declared scope only with published rules and test cases.

entries.label: Additional information
entries.native_scope: No additional-information section exists in the native T2 workpaper.
entries.next_step: Add the additional-information questionnaire fields with declared arithmetic impact.
entries.scope_reason: The additional-information section carries CRA questionnaire answers. Its rules are not modelled and it does not affect the declared arithmetic.

entries.label: GIFI - Balance sheet
entries.native_scope: In-workpaper: only selected GIFI closing and opening totals are typed; there is no statement-level GIFI screen.
entries.next_step: The full GIFI code catalogue and statement layout remain open.

entries.label: GIFI - Income statements
entries.native_scope: In-workpaper: ordinary income totals only. There is no income-statement GIFI detail screen.
entries.next_step: Decide whether statement detail is required for the migration cohort.

entries.label: GIFI - Open balance sheet
entries.native_scope: In-workpaper: opening GIFI totals are typed on the corporate workpaper; there is no separate opening-balance screen.
entries.next_step: Keep opening and closing values distinct; the native checks block imbalance.

entries.label: GIFI - Summary income statement
entries.native_scope: No summary income statement view is generated from the native T2 workpaper.
entries.next_step: Generate a GIFI summary income statement from typed GIFI totals.
entries.scope_reason: A generated GIFI income statement needs full statement-level GIFI detail. NXT types selected GIFI totals only.

entries.label: Non-farming income statement
entries.native_scope: Only ordinary active-business income is modelled; no non-farming income statement.
entries.next_step: Add only with a published specification for the affected lines.
entries.scope_reason: Non-farming income is a separate T2 income statement. The native declared scope covers ordinary active-business income only.

entries.label: Tax & Credits
entries.native_scope: Bounded federal and Alberta arithmetic with the declared credits. There is no tax-and-credits tab.
entries.next_step: Expand credits only against sourced rules and boundary tests.

entries.label: Calc & Result
entries.native_scope: In-workpaper: an explicit calculate action produces a versioned snapshot with diagnostics, not a Calc & Result tab.
entries.next_step: None for parity; the snapshot model is stronger than a tab result.

entries.label: Output
entries.native_scope: Native printable HTML workpapers and JSON packages only; no certified T2 output or barcode.
entries.next_step: Official output requires published form and barcode specifications.

entries.label: Provinces/Territories
entries.native_scope: Alberta only. Other provinces and Quebec are not modelled, and the source offers a full jurisdiction list.
entries.next_step: Each added jurisdiction needs its own ruleset and acceptance cases.

entries.label: Amended return
entries.native_scope: No amended-return flag and no amendment workflow for a previously filed return.
entries.next_step: Add an amendment record that supersedes a filed return; filing stays external.
entries.scope_reason: Amendments apply to filed returns. NXT does not file, so there is no filed return to amend; the capability follows the filing gate.

entries.label: Certification of signing officer
entries.native_scope: No signing-officer certification inside the T2 workpaper; electronic signature is a separate NXT module.
entries.next_step: Keep signing separate from calculation; do not imply certification by computing a return.
entries.scope_reason: Signing-officer certification asserts authority to file. NXT deliberately separates signing from calculation and does not certify.

entries.label: T2 MC43 schedule set
entries.native_scope: NXT computes a much smaller declared T2 set. The schedule-by-schedule difference is shown below, not implied.
entries.next_step: Use the coverage table as the T2 migration gate per client.

entries.label: AT1 MC43 schedule set
entries.native_scope: No AT1 schedules are produced.
entries.next_step: Add AT1 schedules from published Alberta forms when available.
entries.scope_reason: AT1 schedules require published Alberta forms and a transmission path; both are external.

entries.label: CO-17 MC41.1.1 schedule set
entries.native_scope: No CO-17 schedules are produced.
entries.next_step: Add CO-17 schedules from published Quebec forms when available.
entries.scope_reason: CO-17 schedules require published Quebec forms and a transmission path; both are external.

t2_schedule_coverage.source_note: Schedules named in the current WebTax4B T2 release note. The list is what the release announcement names, not a complete inventory of every year or schedule.
t2_schedule_coverage.native_note: Schedules computed by the native T2 path for the declared 2025 Alberta scope, including Schedule 8 CCA detail. Filing and official forms are disabled.
